config.aliases: Other model names the server lists and answers to (comma-separated)
config.anthropic_thinking: Anthropic requests that do not ask for thinking: think as the model does (model) or not (on_request)
config.api_monitor: Keep the last 100 requests' prompts and answers in memory for /api-monitor
config.effort_position: Where a non-default reasoning effort goes: start (the default) or end (keeps the cache when it changes)
config.engine_silence_s: End a request when the engine says nothing for this long (default 300 s, 0 = wait)
config.fit_max_tokens: Shorten a max_tokens that does not fit the context (on by default); off: answer 400 like llama.cpp
config.idle_unload_s: Unload the model after this many seconds without requests (0 or empty: never)
config.lazy_load: Start without loading the model; the first request loads it (text only)
config.mtp: Draft layer (MTP): off starts the engine without it (about 1 GB less graphics memory, slower words per second); empty or on: as installed
config.open_browser: Open the chat page in the browser when the model is ready
config.reasoning_budget_tokens: Cap the thinking of every request at this many tokens (0 or empty: no cap)
config.sampling.min_p: Default min_p for requests that send none
config.sampling.temperature: Default temperature for requests that send none (0 = greedy; without it the model card's: 1.0 thinking, 0.7 not)
config.sampling.top_k: Default top_k for requests that send none (1-64)
config.sampling.top_p: Default top_p for requests that send none
config.saved: Saved ({keys}); the earlier file is {file}.bak. Start the model again to use it.
config.vram_reserve_mib: VRAM in MiB the engine leaves free for other programs (engine default 700)
